references.text: Moses complains that he cannot carry the people alone and uses similar language about the burden of leading Israel.
God answers Moses by distributing the burden among seventy elders, showing that leadership was too heavy for one person.
Jethro warns Moses that he will become exhausted if he continues to carry the people's matters alone.
Jethro advises Moses to share the burden with other judges to lighten the work.
Isaiah uses the word 'burden' (משא) in connection with the people's sinful actions that God is weary of carrying.
Moses asks why God has placed the burden of this entire people on him and compares himself to someone carrying a nursing child.
